items.title: 3 Energy Stocks With P E Ratios Under 13
items.summary: Europe faces fresh gas price risks as unusual weather patterns and low storage collide with geopolitical supply issues, keeping energy security squarely in focus. That backdrop puts large oil and gas producers back on your radar, because companies that pull, ship, and process fuel sit closest to the price action. This piece highlights three leading global energy stocks from the screener and explains what makes each one worth a closer look now. The three stocks that follow are just a starting...
